data.retention_policy: Binance retains /futures/data/* for 30 days at every granularity; fundingRate is full history. A day without a capture run is a day of information destroyed.

scheduler.why: the venue retains these series for 30 days only, so a missed day is a day of information destroyed and no later run can recover it

discovery_status: not started: the derivatives series only began existing on 2026-10-07, and the preregistered split is defined below before any result is observed

frozen_split.blocked_until: at least 30 days of continuous capture have accrued, so that the discovery and validation slices are both covered by real observations rather than by a retention edge
frozen_split.rule: a calendar split of the captured span, identical for every series, with the final fifth reserved and never read by discovery

features.definition: bar return divided by ATR over the same bar
features.name: ret_z

features.definition: ATR divided by price, the local volatility level
features.name: atr_pct

features.definition: per-bar proportional change in open interest
features.name: oi_chg

features.definition: per-bar change in oi_chg, i.e. the second difference
features.name: oi_accel

features.definition: most recent settled funding rate, as a decimal
features.name: funding

features.definition: trailing percentile of the global long/short account ratio
features.name: ls_global_pctile

features.definition: trailing percentile of the top-trader position long/short ratio
features.name: ls_top_position_pctile

features.definition: change in short-horizon price momentum, the deterioration term
features.name: momentum_delta

hypotheses.direction_rule: LONG when ret_z > breakout_ret_z and oi_chg > oi_expanding and taker_imbalance > taker_imbalance_confirm and |funding| <= funding_extreme_abs
hypotheses.invalidation: no forward continuation on average, or the effect is carried by one trade, or the sign does not survive the four sub-windows
hypotheses.mechanism: a breakout accompanied by rising open interest is new positioning rather than short covering, and aggressive buyers confirm it, so the move continues
hypotheses.name: BREAKOUT_CONFIRMATION

hypotheses.direction_rule: SHORT when max(ls_global_pctile, ls_top_position_pctile) >= crowding_pctile and funding > funding_elevated and momentum_delta < momentum_deteriorating
hypotheses.expected_regime: any; crowding is the conditioning variable
hypotheses.invalidation: positioning normalises without a reversal, or the reversal is symmetric (the mirror long arm is not tested, so a symmetric result is not an edge)
hypotheses.mechanism: when published positioning is crowded long and the carry is stretched, the marginal buyer is already in and the move mean-reverts when momentum fades
hypotheses.name: CROWDED_POSITION_REVERSAL

hypotheses.direction_rule: LONG if ret_z > breakout_ret_z, SHORT if ret_z < -breakout_ret_z, in both cases only when oi_chg > oi_expanding and taker_imbalance aligns with the sign of ret_z by more than taker_imbalance_confirm
hypotheses.expected_regime: any; open-interest expansion is the conditioning variable
hypotheses.invalidation: the expansion subset does not out-return the collapse subset, or the effect is driven by a single directional episode
hypotheses.mechanism: a strong move with expanding open interest and aligned aggressor flow is new risk being taken, while the same move with collapsing open interest is positions being closed and carries no continuation
hypotheses.name: FLOW_CONTINUATION_VS_EXHAUSTION

non_traded_arms.name: SHORT_COVERING_CONTRAST
non_traded_arms.role: the declared comparator for H1: it is reported as a differential and may never be promoted into a traded hypothesis

non_traded_arms.name: EXHAUSTION_CONTRAST
non_traded_arms.role: the declared comparator for H3: declared NO_TRADE, reported as a differential and never promoted

parent.not_reopened: no OHLCV hypothesis, threshold or horizon from ALPHA-001 is re-tested

prohibitions: no threshold tuning after results are seen
no adding or removing a hypothesis after results are seen
no re-use of the ALPHA-001 holdout for an ALPHA-001 question
registry.question: Does adding information about market participants produce an out-of-sample effect large enough to clear the economic hurdle?

statistical_gate.admission_rule: gross mean per trade must clear cost + 25% execution uncertainty + the RFC-023 winner's-curse buffer + z_{0.975} * sigma / sqrt(n_effective), with every term frozen before any result is observed
statistical_gate.concentration_gate: top-1 trade share > 0.25 or net excluding the best trade < 0 is FRAGILE
statistical_gate.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.10 and Holm at alpha = 0.10
statistical_gate.stability_gate: gross mean must keep its sign across four sub-windows

registry.title: Derivatives Positioning & Order-Flow Alpha
